label: H.R. 556
title: Protecting Access for Hunters and Anglers Act

items.snippet: of 2025 This bill bars the Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), the Bureau of Land Management (BLM), and the Forest Service from prohibiting or regulating the use of lead ammunition or tackle on federal land or water.
